INSTITUTE OF MOUNTAIN ENVIRONMENT
UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU, BHADERWAH CAMPUS
(NAAC accredited A+ University)
Advertisement Notice
Applications are invited from the interested candidates in the Department of Wildlife Protection,
Government of J&K sponsored project as per the details below:
S.
No
Project Position Number
01 Biodiversity assessment, documentation and
conservation plan of wild flora and fauna including
Management Plan of Bani Wildlife Sanctuary
Junior Research Fellow 01
The position will be purely temporary and shall be for one year. Interested candidates can apply for the same
on prescribed format and as per details provided on the websites of University of Jammu
(www.jammuuniversity.ac.in) and Bhaderwah Campus (www.bhaderwahcampus.in). The application should
be emailed to neerajsharma@jammuuniversity.ac.in along with a hardcopy posted to Dr. Neeraj Sharma C/O
Department of Environmental Sciences, University of Jammu, Jammu - 180006 OR IME, Bhaderwah Campus,
Bhaderwah - 182222. Last date for receiving the applications (both in soft and hard) is 15 days from the date
of publication of this advertisement. The scheduled time and date for interview shall be communicated
separately through email / mobile.
Eligibility: First class M.Sc. in Environmental Science / Ecology / Botany / Biodiversity and allied, with 65%
marks or CGPA / CPI grading of 6.84 on a 10 scale or equivalent. The candidates with background in plant
ecology / taxonomy shall be preferred.
Applicants must be NET qualified.
Remuneration per month: Junior Research Fellow (INR- 37,000.00 + 9% HRA);
Upper age limit : As per UGC norms
Headquarter: Institute of Mountain Environment, Bhaderwah Campus, University of Jammu, Bhaderwah
Study area: The study area encompasses more than 100 km2 of rugged landscape comprising temperate and
a sizable proportion of alpine and nival landscapes in upper Bhaderwah and Bani. Candidates may take note
that the project requires intensive and prolonged fieldwork in extreme environmental conditions.
Sd/
Dr. Neeraj Sharma
(Principal Investigator)
Mobile : 8082397928, 9419213893
Email : neerajsharma@jammuuniversity.ac.in
